visualReview.method: Agent viewed full-resolution saved screenshots with view_image after the final Creator build regression.

findings.result: Frost pillars now retain a narrow upright shape instead of a horizontally flattened slab; feet remain on the same ground contact, and ground crests retain their original projected footprint. Frost arch, foliage and snowflake crest visibly differ from courtyard props.

Hollow cyan shield, upright orange fire burst, pointed ice shards and gold directional slash are visibly distinct at combat size, without baked rectangular backgrounds. Debug proves real skill cue frame advancement 12→13, 0→1, 4→5 and 8→9.

With 20 real friendly nova casts near the mirror Boss ring, decorative VFX yielded (active=0). In the normal screenshot both thin outer and inner danger boundaries remain visible and the center safe zone stays unfilled; F3 confirms matching projected geometry. Normal boundary contrast is subtle but readable on this pale frost ground.

Both new strike patches were selected by real enemy attack poses. The extended arm stays inside its sprite instead of being cut at a neighboring cell; phaseI oval mirror and phaseII diamond mirror remain distinct.

limitations: One desktop Chrome viewport / DPR run; not a four-player or device performance certification.
Danger readability evidence covers the captured mirror ring and lane scenes; no claim of every possible multiplayer overlay.
Natural rewards / skill replacement were deliberately excluded from this art regression.

remaining: Strict limited palette, binary alpha, logical texel grid and integer display require dedicated art refinement (ART-04).
Four-player visibility and GPU frame-time performance not measured (ART-04).
Some older monster moves share intact poses; two mirror patches are shared release poses; other enemies retain two walk keys and single death/hurt poses (ART-05).
Lightning/healing/mist, projectile travel and authoritative warning cores remain Graphics; not every skill or augment has a bespoke texture (ART-05).
No new natural full-campaign/reward or public multiplayer regression claimed for this rendering task.
